Match the reference's affluent ancestral mansion craftsmanship: rich dark brown timber, thick well-maintained beams, deeply carved joinery and selective subdued bronze-gold details, clean pale plaster, natural blue-gray stone and gray tile. Existing trees remain in their original positions, but any seasonal correction uses evergreen pine/shrubs and restrained winter white plum on mostly bare branches, never lush summer foliage or a pink cherry blossom festival. Do not create new courtyards, pools, doorways, buildings or obstacles in the central route. Target: roofed connecting passage with successive rectangular doorframes. Correct heavy amber haze and aged stained plaster; give the timber lintels and existing fascia slightly richer deep carved workmanship consistent with the reference corridor without moving or thickening pillars into the walkway. Retain the receding rectangular openings and stone path, blossom tree silhouettes and garden edge. Turn dense flower clouds into elegant winter plum branches, keep natural unevenness only subtly in well-maintained stone. This is a separate connecting passage, not a copy of the reference long veranda.
